llm.error.context_budget: The request cannot fit the configured window of {window} tokens with {output} reserved for the reply. Reduce the output limit or required instructions, or set the model's actual window.
llm.error.context_provider: The provider rejected the request because it exceeded the context window. Check the model's actual window. The profile specifies {window} tokens with {output} reserved for the reply.
llm.error.gigachat_no_structured_output: GigaChat client does not support with_structured_output: update langchain-gigachat or disable llm.gigachat.structured_output
llm.error.gigachat_proxy_url: GigaChat reads its proxy from the server's HTTP_PROXY and HTTPS_PROXY settings.
llm.error.invalid_proxy_url: Enter an HTTP or HTTPS proxy address such as http://user:password@proxy.example:8080.
llm.error.output_truncated: {provider}: the answer was cut off at {max_tokens} tokens
llm.error.output_truncated_with_count: {provider}: the answer was cut off at {max_tokens} tokens, {output_tokens} produced
llm.error.proxy_failed: The proxy connection failed. Check the proxy address and credentials.
llm.error.quota_exhausted: The model provider reported insufficient quota or balance (HTTP 429). Check the API account limits and billing status.
llm.error.rate_limited: The model provider returned HTTP 429. Check concurrency, request and token limits for the API account.
llm.error.request_timeout: The model provider did not respond within the request timeout.
llm.prompt.compact_critic: Repair DRAFT using the evidence in DATA_CONTEXT. Return only a report JSON object with verdict, verdict_rationale, findings and recommended_actions. Keep supported figures and their units.
llm.prompt.compact_domain: Analyze metrics for the {domain} domain. Ground findings in the supplied JSON values and intervals. Respect deterministic_sla when present. Return the report object with verdict, verdict_rationale, findings and recommended_actions.
llm.prompt.compact_final: Build the final report from deterministic_sla, metrics, load steps and domain_analyses. Preserve the SLA verdict and distinguish target load from capacity. Return JSON with verdict, verdict_rationale, findings and recommended_actions.
